why: A buyer of GPU hours compares named clouds, not two clouds. This file holds the H100/A100/B200 rows of the five clouds that appear in the typed query list (probe106.py), read from each vendor's own pricing page on the date shown. DigitalOcean and Novita rows already live in gpu-hours.json and are NOT duplicated here.
